deviations: Weak-runtime fallback was used: three directions were produced serially as isolated self-contained HTML files rather than by subagents.
No official brand identity or design system was supplied; invented labels, colors, review timing and simulated failure controls are explicitly marked Mock.

Browser QA used headless Google Chrome through an external CDP harness because Playwright was unavailable in the worktree. CDP console/pageerror events, screenshots and task results were persisted; Chrome stderr environment noise is stored separately and is not counted as page evidence.
